Title: Starter deck lists: Who is right?

Messages.Author: Fred Scott
Messages.Body:
Looking at the Lasombra's starter deck lists, it
lists all the starter-only library cards as
being printed one per deck. But in the "official"
White Wolf card lists, they appear to suggest
that two copies are printed per starter deck.
Under the circumstances, I'd love to believe
the official list but Jeff's got everything
counted out carefully so I suspect this is a
misprint in the official list.

Could someone confirm or deny this?

For instance, Palace Hunting Ground is
listed at:

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=Cardlist_P#Palace_Hunting_Ground

You will see it designated as "PG2", indicating -
under normal circumstances - that it is only
in the Guruhi preconstructed deck and that two
copies would be found there.

Fred
